Key Account Manager – Retail (U.S. Market)

Location: Remote in USA
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Key Account Manager to manage and grow our retail business in the U.S. market. This role will be responsible for retailer onboarding, commercial negotiations, contract management, and day-to-day account operations with major U.S. retailers.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with big-box retailers and understands how to navigate retail systems, commercial terms, and cross-functional coordination in a fast-paced consumer product environment.

Key Responsibilities

Out-reach to new retailers to establish new accounts.

Retail Account Development & Onboarding

Lead retailer onboarding processes with major U.S. retailers such as Home Depot, Lowe’s, Costco, Best Buy, and similar accounts

Coordinate internal teams to complete retailer setup, including item onboarding, system configuration, and compliance documentation

Manage retailer-specific requirements, guidelines, and operational standards

Commercial Negotiation & Contract Management

Lead commercial negotiations including pricing, margin structure, promotional funding, rebates, chargebacks, and payment terms

Review, negotiate, and manage retailer contracts and annual agreements

Work closely with legal and finance teams to ensure contract compliance and risk control

Order Management & Account Operations

Oversee purchase order (PO) management, order forecasting, and fulfillment coordination

Monitor order flow, delivery schedules, and inventory status to ensure on-time execution

Manage retailer portals and systems (e.g., Retail Link, Lowe’s systems, Costco vendor portals)

Account Performance & Relationship Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned key accounts

Build strong working relationships with retail buyers, planners, and merchandising teams

Track account performance, sales trends, and key KPIs

Identify growth opportunities including assortment expansion, new product launches, and promotional programs

Cross-Functional Coordination

Work closely with supply chain, operations, after-sales, marketing, and finance teams to support account execution

Coordinate retail returns, chargebacks, deductions, and operational issues

Support new product launches and seasonal planning

Qualifications

3+ years of experience managing U.S. retail key accounts

Proven experience working with major U.S. retailers (Home Depot, Lowe’s, Costco, Best Buy, Walmart, or similar)

Strong understanding of retail commercial terms, contract structures, and negotiation processes

Experience in outdoor equipment, lawn & garden, power tools, robotics, or consumer electronics (3C) strongly preferred

Familiar with retailer systems, PO processes, and retail compliance requirements

Strong communication and negotiation skills

Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities in a fast-paced environment

Position Overview
MAMMOTION is seeking a proactive, hands-on National Dealer Development & Operations Manager to support the expansion and operational improvement of our dealer network across the United States.
This hybrid role combines national dealer development, field sales support, and cross-functional operational coordination. The ideal candidate will be comfortable developing new business opportunities, conducting product demonstrations, supporting regional sales teams, and collaborating with our headquarters in China to address operational challenges.
This position plays a key role in strengthening our dealer network, improving dealer satisfaction, and enabling our field sales team to focus on revenue growth.
Key Responsibilities
1. National Dealer Development
• Identify, prospect, and develop new dealers, distributors, and commercial customers across U.S. territories not currently covered by Regional Sales Managers (RSMs).
• Conduct dealer visits, product demonstrations, and business development meetings throughout the country.
• Build relationships with prospective partners and support dealer onboarding and initial business development.
• Identify and qualify new sales opportunities, coordinating lead assignments and follow-up activities with the appropriate RSMs.
• Provide flexible field support to regional sales teams during key sales opportunities, product demonstrations, trade shows, and dealer events.
2. Dealer Network Operations & Support
• Work closely with the North American sales team, customer service, and headquarters to identify and address recurring dealer operational challenges.
• Coordinate improvements to dealer support programs, spare parts availability, and the Dealer Portal.
• Help develop and improve standardized dealer onboarding, communication, and support processes.
• Gather feedback from dealers and regional sales teams, prioritize operational issues, and follow through with relevant departments to drive timely resolutions.
• Support the development and implementation of dealer programs to improve dealer satisfaction, engagement, and long-term retention.
3. Cross-Functional Coordination
• Serve as a key coordination point between the North American field sales organization and China headquarters.
• Collaborate with sales, service, supply chain, finance, and other departments to improve dealer-facing processes.
• Track operational improvement initiatives, communicate progress, and escalate unresolved issues when necessary.
• Support improvements to internal workflows, communication efficiency, and execution of dealer-related initiatives.
• Assist with the coordination of dealer financing and floor-planning initiatives in collaboration with the sales and finance teams.
4. Sales Team Support & Reporting
• Maintain visibility into national dealer development opportunities and activities.
• Coordinate lead distribution, demonstrations, and follow-up with RSMs to ensure clear ownership and accountability.
• Monitor dealer feedback, operational issues, and the progress of improvement initiatives.
• Provide regular updates to the Head of Sales, North America on dealer development, field activities, and operational priorities.

Qualifications
Required
• 5+ years of experience in channel sales, dealer development, distribution management, or related commercial roles in the U.S. market.
• Strong understanding of U.S. dealer and distribution business models.
• Demonstrated experience developing dealer relationships and supporting field sales activities.
• Strong project coordination, problem-solving, and execution skills.
• Ability to communicate effectively with both U.S.-based teams and international stakeholders.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
• Willingness and ability to travel frequently throughout the United States.
• Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
Preferred
• Professional proficiency in Mandarin Chinese to facilitate communication with China headquarters.
• Experience working with Chinese manufacturers or international organizations.
• Familiarity with the business practices, communication styles, and operational processes of Chinese companies.
• Experience in outdoor power equipment (OPE), robotic lawn mowers, power equipment, or related industries.
• Experience improving dealer support programs, dealer portals, spare parts coordination, or channel operations.
• Familiarity with dealer financing programs and floor planning.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for a hands-on, adaptable, and results-driven professional who can operate effectively in a fast-growing organization.
The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently, traveling to support dealer development opportunities, and collaborating across departments to turn operational challenges into practical solutions.
This role is ideal for someone who combines strong commercial instincts with operational discipline and enjoys building long-term dealer relationships.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
• New dealer and commercial opportunities developed in uncovered territories.
• Qualified leads generated and successfully transferred to regional sales teams.
• Dealer visits, product demonstrations, and development activities completed.
• Progress and completion of assigned dealer operational improvement initiatives.
• Improvements in dealer onboarding and support processes.
• Timely coordination and resolution of recurring dealer issues.
• Dealer satisfaction and engagement improvements.
